explication: TauriTavern is a cross-platform native SillyTavern client: the frontend preserves the SillyTavern experience while a Rust/Tauri backend exposes native capabilities and compatible local data. In the main workflow, a user requests chat generation in the frontend; the frontend invokes backend commands, which route the request to an AI provider and return a completion or stream. Other product branches cover agent tools, extensions, device sync, migration, and media. README architecture and capabilities inform unsampled branches; source-level wiring is shown only where the excerpts or documentation support it.
